segments.text: We're introducing a small but valuable enhancement to our sales order agent. The ability to define a custom signature that will be automatically included in all generated messages. It can be a signature of a specific sales consultant or just a generic company signature.
To set this up, simply navigate to the agent section, select your agent, and click on setup. Then move to the final panel and enable the option label. Include a signature in the first reply.

Next, click on edit signature. A popup window will appear where you can enter your desired signature. This can include text, images, hyperlinks, or any other elements you typically use in your professional email signature.

Once you click okay, the system will automatically validate the content to ensure nothing harmful or inappropriate has been included. If any issues are detected, it will prevent the signature from being saved.

From that point on, whenever the agent responds to customer input, it will behave as usual, but now with your custom signature appended to the first reply, ensuring consistent and professional communication.
